sourceReview.method: Public original XLSX/HTML download and read-only cell values/definitions; no confidential copy, images, map interpretation, geocoding or application checks

editionProposal.label: SDG&E public July 2026 TPR portfolio
editionProposal.meaning: July 1 is the CPUC cycle release, not a per-row extraction/update date; current/actual milestones and source status can differ.

enumerationProposal.scopeMeaning: Complete declared public workbook row reconciliation, not a deduplicated engineering-project count or all SDG&E capital work. Three unprefixed blanket-budget units remain context; parent project-count cells are not expanded into invented records.

identityProposal.native: Trim outer whitespace from the most-specific AD identifier when it is neither NA, TBD nor Multiple; retain raw value as evidence. These122 retained IDs are unique in this edition.
identityProposal.missing: source-locator: project-list-row-NNN uses the exact A Row No. with its sheet/Excel-row locator, not a native publisher engineering ID. Fifteen retained rows require this.
identityProposal.hierarchy: AE is parent work order; AG is budget code. Preserve those aliases independently. Never promote either to a missing most-specific engineering ID or split multi-ID rows without a contract.
identityProposal.continuity: Source-locator future-edition continuity is unproven; explicit crosswalk review required. AH contains source ID changes; no automatic merge with earlier SDG&E, SCE or other publisher records.

mappingProposal.owner: null for all rows: no asset-owner column; X is a project manager and every X cell is blank. Publisher/reporting utility is not an asset-owner assertion.
mappingProposal.recordKind: 93 retained rows explicitly typed Transmission Line or Substation are transmission-project;44 Other/IT/physical-security/civil/operations/multiple-type records conservatively remain capital-project-context until more specific scope acceptance.
mappingProposal.unit: Project for individually described work; omit recordUnit for the three blanket budgets and other broad grouped/program units. One source row can encompass multiple assets.
mappingProposal.dates: BG is Current Projected or Actual In-Service Date;119 retained exact days and18 unknowns (9 NA,6 TBD,3 Multiple). BF is an original forecast, not fallback current date. BE is actual or expected start, retained as a labeled supplementary milestone. Null constructionStart and buildWindow proposed to avoid implying actual construction or a complete interval.
mappingProposal.lifecycle: BC controls planned/under-construction/on-hold; no completed inference from a past date, approval boolean, or present calendar. Source edition as-of2026-07-01; sourceUpdatedOn null.
mappingProposal.geography: C/D blank for all367 rows; location/nativeGeometry null, centerRole unknown. E is source city/county/multiple text, not coordinates or a state field. CRS/role/accuracy unknown.
mappingProposal.cost: BK original forecast is explicitly at parent-work-order scope; BM current projected fully-loaded/actual final cost is in $000. Preserve raw label and units in source evidence, do not sum parent/child rows or substitute these for hypothetical shared-corridor savings. Core Project has no cost field.
mappingProposal.voltage: AA is line voltage kV; AB mixes transformer capacity MVA and voltage kV. Parse only explicit voltage numbers, retain raw distinctions; never read an MVA number as kV. Y is line miles, Z acres, neither supplies a route or center.

conflicts.meaning: Preserve conflicts and source labels; do not repair dates, reclassify by elapsed time, infer cancellation or merge reused IDs.

diagnosticPayload.meaning: Sizing only of six proposed Project objects in a projects wrapper; not a runtime dataset or validated producer result. Qualification ledger/source facts are not runtime payload.
diagnosticPayload.estimateMethod: 137 × twice the largest formatted diagnostic record +16KiB manifest/coverage allowance. Assumes concise descriptions/notes and no redundant whole-row/source-text dumps; actual producer payload must be reported.
